intro: The Adriana wardrobe fits busy homes beautifully. It keeps essentials organised, stands up to everyday use, and adds safety touches that make a real difference.

features.title: Durable finish that stands up to life
features.text: Our Duralam laminated finish resists stains, scratches & daily wear, so your wardrobe stays fresh and easy to maintain, even in busy homes.

features.title: Quality hardware for lasting ease
features.text: Fitted with premium hardware, every hinge, handle, and fitting works smoothly — our design ensures doors open easily and shelves stay securely in place for years.

features.title: Strong edges that add protection
features.text: Each panel is edge-banded with 1mm thick PVC, sealing the wardrobe’s structure while adding extra durability and keeping moisture and damage at bay.

features.title: Built to handle daily use
features.text: Crafted from prelaminated particle board, our wardrobe offers a sturdy frame that holds up to everyday use, keeping your essentials safe and your space organised.

features.title: Shelves that fit your changing needs
features.text: Whether you need space for seasonal clothes, folded essentials, or accessories, Adriana’s shelves let you customise your storage with ease.

name: Adriana 2-Door Wooden Wardrobe Walnut
